tei:div.tei:p: The “Pledge of Allegiance to the Family of Earth” was offered by the Women’s Foreign Policy Council (co-chaired by Bella Abzug and Mim Kelber). The earliest publication of the pledge that we were able to located is as found in the article, “Earthlings Unite” by Nina Combs in Ms. Magazine, vol. 18:1&2 (July/August 1989), p. 19. The pledge may also have been published slightly earlier by Worldwide News: World Women in Environment (May/June 1989). That reference was cited by Loe Rose Mbise in her address “I have heard the cry of my people for a liberated creation” at the Proceedings, the Eighth Assembly, Lutheran World Federation, Curitiba, Brazil, January 29 to February 8, 1990 (p. 77). If you have access to a copy of Worldwide News: World Women in Environment (May/June 1989) or any further information on this pledge, please leave a comment (or contact us).
For Earth Day 2025 I offered the Hebrew translation, revised with input from Shaul Vardi. (Thank you!) –Aharon Varady
